column7: [FEATURE] Give users control over weekly limit reset timing (configurable reset day, or banked on-demand resets like Codex)
[FEATURE] Desktop app: two-way voice chat with any session of a project (the Codex app already offers this)
Desktop Code tab: auto-collapse a turn's thinking and tool calls when the task finishes (like Codex's "Worked for X min")
[BUG] subscribe_pr_activity delivers human review events but not bot review events (from GitHub Apps like chatgpt-codex-connector[bot] and gemini-code-assist[bot])
Feature request: Codex-style live steering (inject input into the in-flight turn)
[FEATURE] Visible context-window usage indicator in Cowork (parity with Codex / Claude Code status line)
[FEATURE] Cowork built-in browser: apply View → Zoom to the browser pane when it has focus (persisted, like Codex)
[FEATURE] Support additional skills search paths (e.g. .agents/skills/) to enable sharing with Codex and Gemini
Feature request: Remote Control parity with Codex "Control this Mac" (all projects, unified host view, device-to-device control, handoff)
Feature request: import/sync sessions from Codex, mirroring ChatGPT's existing "import from Claude Code" feature
Feature request: expose a session-rename tool to the agent (like Codex's set_thread_title)
[FEATURE] Desktop app should keep Remote Control connected automatically across app updates (Codex-style always-on)
[FEATURE] VS Code extension: add a command to add a file or folder to the chat (like Codex's chatgpt.addFileToThread)
Feature request: make usage/spend glanceable by default (parity with Codex), not buried behind a command
[FEATURE] Compose-while-working with send-time choice of interrupt vs queue (Codex-style)
[BUG] You made Opus dumb again and I'm officially moving to codex.
[FEATURE] First-class `claude remote-control serve`: register machines as devices and start sessions from mobile (parity with Codex / Antigravity)
Feature request: mobile Remote Control should be able to take over any local session (like Codex mobile)
[Feature Request] Fast mode in the desktop app (Code tab): meter it against plan usage at a multiplier, like Codex, instead of a separate usage-credits wallet
I'm canceling 2 of my 3 Claude plans. I added Codex and Gemini. I cannot keep Claude on task, and I've spent two years trying to out-engineer it. I'm tired.
Demonstrable regression: Claude Code vs Codex 5.5 — same prompt, incomparable results (Feb–Apr 2026)
Feature Request: Separate /-prefix (commands) from skills/agents picker (Codex-style)
[FEATURE] Add /goal command for persistent thread-level objectives (parity with Codex CLI 0.128.0)
An open letter from a power user: Claude Code is losing the terminal to Codex
[Feature Request] Add Codex sync-to-local feature
[Bug] Codex vs. Opus: Code Review Speed and Token Consumption Comparison
[FEATURE] Clear terminal scrollback on /clear, consistent with Codex CLI
[Bug] Custom Home Assistant integration flagged as cyber risk; Codex does not
[Bug] Claude Code deletes user files when Codex is mentioned in conversation
